product_family: Brilliant is an AI-powered interactive learning platform offering 90+ courses in math, computer science, science, and data analysis. The platform includes Koji, an AI personal tutor, and serves students from grade 5 through college. Includes Brilliant for Educators program for schools.

privacy.ai_training_note: Brilliant explicitly states they do NOT use or allow AI chat data to be used to train any third-party AI models. Platform uses AI chat data solely to improve their own AI features and services. Voice recordings are not stored or retained; voice input is processed only to generate text transcriptions and then discarded. AI chat conversations are retained indefinitely for improvement purposes.
privacy.data_region: Not publicly specified; GDPR compliance implied for EU data

security.name: Voice input handling
security.value: Voice input is not stored or retained; it is processed by a third-party speech-to-text provider under zero-data-retention terms solely to generate text transcriptions, then discarded.

security.name: Data deletion
security.value: Users can request deletion of AI chat conversations; voice recordings automatically discarded after transcription.

products.name: Brilliant (Consumer)
products.data_scope: Student learning progress, course interactions, AI chat inputs (text, voice, image, video), user account data
products.notes: Serves individual learners grade 5 through college. Features Koji AI tutor. 10M+ learners globally. Subscription-based model.

products.name: Brilliant for Educators
products.data_scope: Student learning progress, course interactions, classroom data via educator accounts
products.notes: Designed for schools and educators. Includes Data Privacy Agreements for schools. Compliant with FERPA, COPPA, GDPR.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription (free and premium tiers for individuals; enterprise pricing for schools)
compare.data_residency: Not publicly specified; GDPR compliance stated but data center location not disclosed

flags: No trust center found on the vendor's own domain (brilliant.org). The domain brilliantmade.com / brilliant.tech belongs to a different, unrelated company (Brilliant Home Technology / Brilliant NextGen, a smart-home hardware maker in San Mateo); its trust center and security documentation do NOT apply to brilliant.org and were removed from this assessment
Encryption/MFA/password-hashing details are not published on brilliant.org's own domain; the previously cited facts came from the unrelated smart-home company and have been stripped
No evidence of enterprise-grade certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) found in public documentation
Company is growth-stage EdTech, not traditional enterprise SaaS; certification posture reflects educational market norms, not fintech/healthcare standards
Brilliant.org is primarily an educational platform, not an AI tool in the traditional AIFOXX sense (not an LLM API, image generator, or generative AI service)
Data residency not publicly documented; GDPR compliance implied but specific regions not stated
AI training policy is favorable (no third-party training) but unclear whether this applies to free vs. paid tiers or to educator programs
